note: Golden output digests of research_cycle.py run on the tiny_world fixture (scripts/specs/tiny.json, seed 7), one entry per executable build type (G-P8: green on every build tag). Null until root records it after a build: python scripts/tests/test_cycle_e2e.py --record --bin <dir of the equity executables> --build-type Debug|Release (or research-build.ps1 -Canary -CanaryRecord). outputs: u_orientations_json_sha256 (u pass orientations.json, file SHA-256), fit_admission_decisions_sha256 (admission.json canonical JSON without its inputs block: that block pins the u pass summary.json, whose wall_seconds and cache hit counts change every run, and the fitter's own script SHA-256), fit_weights_sha256 (composition_weights.json canonical JSON of schema, signs and weights only: its provenance carries the u summary SHA and the fitter's script SHA), w_combined_f64_sha256 (the w pass train_combined.f64 payload) and nav_primary_daily_csv_sha256 (the NAV primary scenario daily CSV). fields_manifest_sha256 names the world these goldens belong to (scripts/specs/tiny.json fields.manifest_sha256); a relocked world needs new goldens. superseded_v1 keeps the v1 digests recorded before the P9 seal block moved the fields manifest (orientations.json embeds its SHA-256); nothing reads it.
